description: Findings the gate accepts today, each with the reason no existing same-valued token can replace the literal without a design call, a class-name change or a density change. An entry that stops matching fails the run, so the list shrinks as tokens.map.json grows. A zero (0) is never a finding and `opacity: 1` is the identity. See the header of check-no-hardcoded.mjs for the exact definition of a finding.

exemptFiles.reason: Forge 2046 direction tables. tokens.ts reads the instrument, chrome and lab tiers from them, so they are token sources.
SVG path data for the drawn glyphs, not style values.

entries.reason: packages/media-ui is outside this pass (owned by another change). tokens.map.json has the row (--spacing-fixed-element, 8); media-ui cannot import studio-workspace tokens, so it needs its own token module when it adopts them.
